sentiment: Early morning on a coast road with the windows down, the sea flashing silver between the hills, friends singing along to the radio as the day opens wide ahead of them.
On the last evening before the move, a family stands in the emptied house; pale rectangles mark where the pictures hung, and a child touches the doorframe once more before the lights go out.
Rain streaks the windows of a late bus crawling through the city; a passenger checks the time again and again, counting the stops, afraid the last train will leave before they reach the station.
Snow falls on a mountain monastery at dawn; a single bell sounds across the white courtyard, smoke rises straight from the kitchen chimney, and the whole valley holds its breath in silence.
